compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is part of a setup or questionnaire process aimed at achieving optimal results for a specific function, likely related to health or cycle tracking. The screen asks the user if they know their shortest and longest cycle lengths in the past year. There are two radio button options for the user to select: "Yes" or "No." The "No" option is currently selected. At the bottom of the screen, there are two navigation buttons: "BACK" on the left and "NEXT" on the right, allowing the user to move to the previous or next screen, respectively.
